steps.title: Verify eng.traineddata asset file copying and path resolution
steps.description: Ensure eng.traineddata is copied into context.getFilesDir()/tesseract/tessdata/eng.traineddata and log existence and file length.

steps.title: Configure Tesseract reflection probing for dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract components
steps.description: Probe constructors, methods, and parameters for TesseractInitializer, TesseractOCR, TesseractJNI, TesseractResult, and TesseractWord.

steps.title: Initialize Tesseract OCR engine across available constructors and init methods
steps.description: Attempt reflection instantiation and setup across TesseractOCR and TesseractJNI using context and asset directory paths.

steps.title: Implement diagnostic logger for OCR initialization and traineddata file status
steps.description: Log detailed diagnostic state including file paths, byte sizes, tried constructors, init status, and reflection exceptions.

steps.title: Enhance ProductScannerResult to capture barcode, raw OCR text, and diagnostic reports
steps.description: Ensure ProductScannerResult encapsulates both barcode/QR data, full raw OCR text, and diagnostic status fallback.

steps.title: Update OcrScannerHelper bitmap preprocessing and multi-angle recognition
steps.description: Perform multi-angle bitmap rotation (0, 90, 270, 180 degrees) with high-contrast grayscale preprocessing for OCR recognition.

steps.title: Implement complete text extraction logic with Luhn IMEI and spec parser
steps.description: Extract brand, model, IMEI 1/2 with Luhn validation, serial, RAM, storage, and color while preserving full OCR text.

steps.title: Create diagnostic summary generator for fallback when raw OCR text is empty
steps.description: Generate concise [OCR-DIAG] report containing traineddata size, candidate reflection methods, init status, and failure cause when OCR yields empty text.

steps.title: Update ScanLogManager saveScanLog to unify Barcode/QR and full OCR/OCR-DIAG text
steps.description: Combine detected Barcode/QR code and full raw OCR text or [OCR-DIAG] diagnostic summary into a unified fullText log entry.

steps.title: Integrate camera scan text capture into ScanLogManager
steps.description: Pass live camera scan results (barcode/QR + full OCR or [OCR-DIAG]) directly to ScanLogManager.saveScanLog.

steps.title: Integrate gallery upload scan text capture into ScanLogManager
steps.description: Pass gallery image upload scan results (barcode/QR + full OCR or [OCR-DIAG]) directly to ScanLogManager.saveScanLog.

steps.title: Update history subtab UI to auto-refresh scan text log on tab switch
steps.description: Ensure Scan Text Log list reloads fresh entries when switching subtabs in History view.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Build box-stock-manager APK with unified full-text logging for Camera and Gallery scans, dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract OCR integration, and diagnostic reporting.
